links.outcome: Stability of SHAP explanations under Gaussian noise, brightness and contrast perturbations, DenseNet121 vs ViT
links.effect: ViT explanations were more stable under perturbation (89% accuracy, 0.948 ROC-AUC). DenseNet121 was more accurate (91%, 0.965) with more localized explanations. Stability differences were significant (p<0.001).
links.quote: Based on statistical analysis, significant differences among the two models in terms of the stability of the explanations obtained were found (p<0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the stability and robustness of SHAP explanations under input perturbations (noise, brightness, contrast) across two deep learning architectures on a benchmark breast histopathology dataset.
